name: Tsukamattara Soku, Gyaku Rape Gakuen ~Shi ni Monogurui de Ore o Okashi ni Kuru Onna-tachi~
original_name: つかまったら即、逆レイプ学園 ～死に物狂いで俺を犯しにくるオンナたち～
source:
Kou Kisaka is the only guy in the entire school and he gets assalted from all sides by a legion of insane girls.
If he can just survive 3 more days, he'll be able to transfer out of school. 
Until then he's constantly on the brink of slavery: if any girl gets him then his sperm will be squeezed to the last drop and that will be the end of his freedom...
